result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.select_edges()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Select edges using a predicate function. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L7266-L7336){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.select_edges(predicate) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} ![Select edges by predicate](/assets/graphs/select-edges.light.svg){.lightbox fig-alt="A six-node grid whose seven edges are labeled with weights. After selecting with the predicate weight greater than 0.5, the four edges weighing 0.8, 0.6, 0.9, and 0.7 are selected and drawn in the accent color; the rest stay plain." width="100%"} Applies a custom filter function to all edges, selecting those for which the predicate returns `True`. The predicate receives an Edge object with properties: `id`, `source`, `target`, `weight`, and other attributes. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [predicate]{.doc-parameter-name} : Function that takes an `Edge` object and returns `bool`. Should return `True` to select the edge. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Graph]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Self for method chaining. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} The predicate receives each edge's `Edge` object, so filters can key off `weight`, endpoints, or any custom attribute. Here, only edges above a weight threshold are selected: ::: {#1082a6d9 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_node("A") .add_node("B") .add_node("C") .add_node("D") .add_edge("A", "B", weight=0.3) .add_edge("B", "C", weight=0.8) .add_edge("C", "D", weight=0.6) .select_edges(lambda e: e.weight and e.weight > 0.5) ) graph.count_selected_edges() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 2 ``` ::: ::: Filtering on `e.attributes` instead selects by relationship type or any other custom edge attribute: ::: {#54d4a963 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_node("A") .add_node("B") .add_node("C") .add_edge("A", "B", rel="friend") .add_edge("B", "C", rel="colleague") .select_edges(lambda e: e.attributes and e.attributes.get("rel") == "friend") ) graph.count_selected_edges() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` 1 ``` ::: :::
